title: Dave M NDE 7853/8135 NDE 8135
content:
8135 I awoke with really bad chest pain. At first, I thought it was bad heartburn, but then the pain became unbearable. I knew I was having a heart attack and called 911. The first call didn't go through and was just digital noise. I called again and it rang. A 911 operator answered and the first thing I did, in case I passed out, was give her my address. Then I explained that I was having a heart attack. She asked a bunch of questions like ‘was I in a cold sweat?’ I answered, 'yes.' ‘Did I have bad chest and arm pain?’ I answered, 'yes.' She said it sounded like a heart attack and had me keep the telephone line open until the medics arrived. They arrive in 4 minutes. I had gotten up to unlock the door so they could get in and then went back to the bed. I was in extreme pain. The emergency medical technicians came in, gave me aspirin, and starting hooking up wires to my chest. After about 5 minutes, my arms went numb and I was panicking. I knew that was it. For some unknown reason, I jumped off the bed onto the carpet. I don't remember hitting the floor. Then after what seemed like a few seconds, I was on the floor and surrounded by a green mist or fog in a real low light. I felt no pain. The place, where I was, seemed so surreal and so pleasant. I was very conscious but seemed to be in another place. I couldn't see anyone, no paramedics or other people. Then I realized that I was dead and I said aloud, 'I'm dead.' I heard a very pleasant woman's voice say 'Yes,' but I didn't see her. It seemed like I was there for at least 20 minutes, but after they revived me I guess my heart only stopped for about 15 seconds. It was as if time was stretched out where I was or maybe it just seemed like a long time to me. I seemed to be planted on the floor. I could move from the waist up with ease but my legs seemed very heavy and I couldn't move. My body was different, so it must have been my spirit body. I could feel everything but had no sensation of pain; it was such a pleasant feeling but very surreal. I wasn't afraid at all and almost didn't want to leave, but I felt like it wasn't my time and wanted to go back to my body. I reached out my arm and after a little while, went into a dream state. I was no longer conscious but was asleep dreaming. I think this is when the paramedics must have revived me. I woke up to a large group of medics all around me, one told me, 'Sir, you just had a heart attack and your heart stopped.' I sat there for a minute and asked them, 'My heart stopped?' They said, 'Yes.' The only thing I could think of to say was, 'Holy crap!' Everyone seemed quite upset since they had just seen me die. I didn't say anything about the experience because I was still trying to process what had just happened to me. I will never forget it. It was a bad and good thing that I went through. It was bad that I had a heart attack but good that I know the answer to a question humanity had wondered about forever - Does our consciousness go on after our body dies. The answer is 100% yes, it does.

arrival.other_being_detail: He heard a very pleasant woman's voice say 'Yes,' but did not see her.

environment.environment_other_detail: Surrounded by a green mist/fog in a real low light; described as surreal and pleasant.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He reached out his arm and after a little while went into a dream state; later woke up with medics around him.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He was on the floor in green mist/fog, realized he was dead, heard a woman's voice, then entered a dream state and woke to medics after revival.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel/light/life review/boundary; experience centered on altered environment and brief communication while on the floor, then return via loss of consciousness/dream state.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Green mist/fog in low light while 'planted on the floor'; legs felt very heavy and immobile while upper body moved easily; transition into a 'dream state' before waking to medics.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'I'm dead.' / A very pleasant woman's voice said 'Yes,' (unseen). / 'Sir, you just had a heart attack and your heart stopped.' / 'Holy crap!' / 'The answer is 100% yes, it does.'
